Here is what I found on the story “Iowa County youth organize 5K for mental health facility,” revised with accurate details and noting what is confirmed vs. what is proposed:

---

## What is happening / what is proposed

Multiple sources describe plans, not a concluded event or facility. The initiative has these confirmed details:

- **Event:** A *fundraising walk / run* (“5K walk / 1-mile walk or run”) called *Run Forward* is scheduled for **Saturday, November 14, 2026**, at 9:00 a.m. at the Iowa County Sheriff’s Office in **Dodgeville, Wisconsin**. ([stayhappening.com](https://stayhappening.com/e/run-forward-5k-1mile-walk-run-E2ISYY5CP7V?utm_source=openai))  
- **Organizer:** Youth Emergency Services (YES), a program associated with the Iowa County Sheriff’s Office. ([runscore.runsignup.com](https://runscore.runsignup.com/Race/WI/Dodgeville/RunForwardRunWalkToBenefitHiddenBeautyRetreat?utm_source=openai))  
- **Purpose:** The event aims to *raise funds* for the creation of the **Hidden Beauty Retreat**, a proposed mental-health and addiction treatment facility reserved *exclusively for first responders*. ([hyperlocalloop.com](https://hyperlocalloop.com/first-responders-5k-walk-supports-hidden-beauty-retreat-mental-health-center-in-iowa-county/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Proposed facility:** Hidden Beauty Retreat is planned as a **25-acre** site for mental health and addiction treatment. ([hyperlocalloop.com](https://hyperlocalloop.com/first-responders-5k-walk-supports-hidden-beauty-retreat-mental-health-center-in-iowa-county/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Support/backing:** Local businesses and Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love are involved in supporting the event and facility proposals. ([hyperlocalloop.com](https://hyperlocalloop.com/first-responders-5k-walk-supports-hidden-beauty-retreat-mental-health-center-in-iowa-county/?utm_source=openai))  

---

## What is *not* yet confirmed or is still planned

These are details that remain in planning/proposal stage, rather than completed or measured outcomes:

- **Facility status:** There is no evidence that the Hidden Beauty Retreat has yet been built or opened. The campaign remains in the fundraising/proposal phase. ([hyperlocalloop.com](https://hyperlocalloop.com/first-responders-5k-walk-supports-hidden-beauty-retreat-mental-health-center-in-iowa-county/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Funding or land acquired:** As of the latest reporting, it’s not confirmed that the land for the retreat has been purchased or that construction has begun. ([hyperlocalloop.com](https://hyperlocalloop.com/first-responders-5k-walk-supports-hidden-beauty-retreat-mental-health-center-in-iowa-county/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Outcome of the 5K event:** Because the event is scheduled for Nov 14, 2026, there are no reports yet of its results (attendance, money raised, follow-through). ([stayhappening.com](https://stayhappening.com/e/run-forward-5k-1mile-walk-run-E2ISYY5CP7V?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Summary and assessment

| Element | Confirmed | Proposed / Planned |
|---|---|---|
| 5K walk/run event | ✔ Scheduled for Nov 14, 2026, in Dodgeville, Wisconsin for first responders’ mental health support. | — |
| Hidden Beauty Retreat facility | ✔ A proposed 25-acre mental health/addiction treatment center exclusively for first responders. | — |
| Facility opening or construction | — | Still in planning/fundraising, not yet built or opened. |
| Measured outcomes (funds raised, beneficiaries served) | — | Not yet available. |

---

## Sources

- Event registration page (“Run Forward”) provides primary source information about the date, location, organizer, pricing, and that proceeds go to Hidden Beauty Retreat. ([runscore.runsignup.com](https://runscore.runsignup.com/Race/WI/Dodgeville/RunForwardRunWalkToBenefitHiddenBeautyRetreat?utm_source=openai))  
- Hyperlocal reporting (Hyperlocal Loop) offers independent coverage that repeats many of the claims, confirms partners like Jordan Love and business backers, and describes the facility as proposed. ([hyperlocalloop.com](https://hyperlocalloop.com/first-responders-5k-walk-supports-hidden-beauty-retreat-mental-health-center-in-iowa-county/?utm_source=openai))  

---

In short, this story reflects a **planned event** and **proposal**, not yet a completed outcome. Youth in Iowa County are organizing a 5K to support the *creation* of a mental health facility for first responders, but the facility itself is not yet established, and final results of the fundraising are not yet available.

Research Note: “Premature baby weighing 850 grams rescued in Ulan-Ude”

---

### ✅ Found Evidence Supporting the Story

There *is* credible reporting on a case from Ulan-Ude involving a premature baby weighing **850 grams** (≈ 1 pound 14 ounces). Key specifics:

- The baby is a **girl** named *Ulyana*. ([news.mail.ru](https://news.mail.ru/society/63702821/?utm_source=openai))  
- She was born **on 28 July 2022**. ([news.mail.ru](https://news.mail.ru/society/63702821/?utm_source=openai))  
- At birth, her weight was **850 grams**, and her length was **34 centimeters**. ([news.mail.ru](https://news.mail.ru/society/63702821/?utm_source=openai))  
- She was born **prematurely**, at **28 weeks’ gestation**. ([news.mail.ru](https://news.mail.ru/society/63702821/?utm_source=openai))  

Additional details of the medical course:

- Immediately after birth, she could not breathe on her own and was placed on mechanical ventilation. ([news.mail.ru](https://news.mail.ru/society/63702821/?utm_source=openai))  
- She spent around **one month in the neonatal intensive care / perinatal center** for initial stabilization. ([dktr24.ru](https://www.dktr24.ru/news/medicine/18112024/6789?utm_source=openai))  
- After that, she was transferred to an intensive therapy and then to a ward for premature and newborn babies. ([dktr24.ru](https://www.dktr24.ru/news/medicine/18112024/6789?utm_source=openai))  
- Over time, with special restorative therapy (including feeding methods and respiratory support), she gained weight and developed appropriately. ([dktr24.ru](https://www.dktr24.ru/news/medicine/18112024/6789?utm_source=openai))  

Outcomes:

- As of the reporting date (November 2024), Ulyana was about **2½ years old**, attending kindergarten, and reportedly “undistinguishable from her peers” in development. ([dktr24.ru](https://www.dktr24.ru/news/medicine/18112024/6789?utm_source=openai))  

---

### ⚠️ Caveats & Clarifications

- The story is **not new**; most reporting dates back to **November 2024**, describing events starting in **2022**. ([dktr24.ru](https://www.dktr24.ru/news/medicine/18112024/6789?utm_source=openai))  
- There is **no indication** that the baby weighed more or less than 850 grams in the original birth (this is the reported birth weight).  
- The claim in the candidate (“rescued in Ulan-Ude”) aligns with these facts but some publications may mistake or rephrase aspects that slightly differ (e.g. 940 g, 990 g etc.), referring to different cases. ([bur.aif.ru](https://bur.aif.ru/society/ne-mogla-dyshat-otkroveniya-materi-rodivshey-dochku-vesom-menshe-kilogramma?utm_source=openai))  

---

### 🔍 Independent Sources

- *Doctor 24* — detailed medical reporting including original statements from the children's republican clinical hospital in Ulan-Ude. ([dktr24.ru](https://www.dktr24.ru/news/medicine/18112024/6789?utm_source=openai))  
- *Mail.ru* — includes an interview with the mother, confirming date, weight, gestational age, and long-term outcome. ([news.mail.ru](https://news.mail.ru/society/63702821/?utm_source=openai))  

---

### 📋 Conclusion

- **What actually happened**: In July 2022, a baby girl named Ulyana was born in Ulan-Ude at 28 weeks gestation, weighing 850 g and measuring 34 cm. Medical team cared for her in NICU with ventilatory support and specialized feeding; by late 2024 she had reached age ~2½, was attending kindergarten, and deemed developmentally within normal range.

- **Is this a launch/pledge/etc.?** No — this is a **measured outcome**, a completed rescue and successful medical treatment with follow-up confirming developmental progress.

- **Multiple reports** exist, but they appear to draw on the same underlying case; some mix with other similar neonatal stories (e.g. 990 g or 940 g babies) but Ulyana’s case is distinct and well-documented across at least two independent sources.

---

If you like, I can attempt to locate the exact press release from the hospital or quote medical journals confirming Ulyana’s latest health metrics.
